verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's structure for the banner: a quote mark, a three-line serif quote on the left, the can sitting on its circle on the right and the logo at bottom-left, with clear hierarchy. Its flaws are small: the attribution is very small and the can's lid crowds the top of the circle. B blows the logo up into the dominant element at the top, shrinks the quote to tiny one-line text with an orphaned 'soon.', and sets the attribution larger than the quote, which inverts the hierarchy. B also runs the backdrop circle under the quote and attribution text and leaves the can small and pushed to the bottom.
